actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.opnform_create_form.description: Creates a new form in a workspace.
actions.opnform_create_form.props.additi: Optional JSON object of other form settings, e.g. {"submitted_text": "Thanks!", "tags": ["leads"], "closes_at": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"}. Also overrides the display defaults: theme "default", presentation_style "classic", width "centered", size "md", border_radius "small", dark_mode "light", color "#3B82F6", uppercase_labels, no_branding and transparent_background false. The fields above take precedence.
actions.opnform_create_form.props.proper: JSON array of form fields. Each needs a unique `id`, a `type` (e.g. "text", "email", "number", "select", "checkbox", "date") and a `name`; optional `required`, `placeholder`, `help`. Example: [{"id": "f1", "type": "text", "name": "Full name", "required": true}].
actions.opnform_create_form.props.worksp: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.
actions.opnform_create_submission.descri: Submits answers to a public form.
JSON object of answers keyed by field id (from Get Form), e.g. {"3700d380-197b-47b9-a008-3acc31bbd506": "Alice", "12461db5-0c19-429e-840b-8de1e359c42f": "alice@example.com"}. Text fields take strings, number fields numbers, checkboxes booleans, multi-selects arrays.
Optional time spent filling the form, in seconds.
The form slug or UUID (the `slug` field), e.g. "customer-feedback-x1y2z3". Use List Forms to find it.

Optional campaign attribution, e.g. {"utm_source": "newsletter", "utm_campaign": "summer-launch"}. Supported keys: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_id, utm_term, utm_content, gclid, fbclid and similar click ids.
actions.opnform_delete_form.props.formId: Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.
Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.
Numeric submission ID, from List Submissions.
actions.opnform_export_submissions.descr: Exports a form's submissions as CSV.
actions.opnform_export_submissions.props: JSON object of the columns to include, keyed by field id (from Get Form) or system column, with true to include, e.g. {"3700d380-197b-47b9-a008-3acc31bbd506": true, "created_at": true}.
Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.opnform_get_current_user.descrip: Gets the OpnForm user that owns the connected API key.
actions.opnform_get_form.description: Gets a form with all its settings and fields.
The form slug or UUID (the `slug` field), e.g. "customer-feedback-x1y2z3". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.opnform_list_forms.description: Lists one page of forms in a workspace.
actions.opnform_list_forms.props.page.de: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
actions.opnform_list_forms.props.workspa: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.
actions.opnform_list_submissions.descrip: Lists one page of submissions for a form.
actions.opnform_list_submissions.props.f: Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.opnform_list_submissions.props.p: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
actions.opnform_list_submissions.props.s: Optional text to search for in the answers.
completed, partial (unfinished submissions, on forms with partial submissions enabled) or all. Leave empty for the API default.
actions.opnform_list_workspace_invites.d: Lists the pending and accepted invites of a workspace.
actions.opnform_list_workspace_invites.p: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.
actions.opnform_list_workspace_users.des: Lists the members of a workspace and their roles.
actions.opnform_list_workspace_users.pro: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.
actions.opnform_list_workspaces.descript: Lists the workspaces the connected user belongs to.
actions.opnform_update_form.description: Updates a form, keeping every setting you leave empty.
actions.opnform_update_form.props.additi: Optional JSON object of other form settings to change, e.g. {"submitted_text": "Thanks!", "closes_at": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"}. The fields above take precedence.
actions.opnform_update_form.props.formSl: The form slug or UUID (the `slug` field), e.g. "customer-feedback-x1y2z3". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.opnform_update_form.props.proper: Optional JSON array that replaces ALL form fields. Start from the `properties` returned by Get Form and keep each field `id`, or existing answers lose their field.
actions.opnform_update_form.props.submis: Automatically delete submissions older than this many units (set together with Retention Unit). Deleted submissions cannot be restored.
New form title, up to 60 characters.
actions.opnform_update_submission.descri: Changes some of a submission's answers.
JSON object of the answers to change, keyed by field id (from Get Form), e.g. {"3700d380-197b-47b9-a008-3acc31bbd506": "Alice Smith"}.
Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.
Numeric submission ID, from List Submissions or Create Submission.
actions.opnform_update_workspace.descrip: Renames a workspace or changes its icon.
actions.opnform_update_workspace.props.e: New emoji icon, e.g. "🚀". Leave empty to keep the current icon.
actions.opnform_update_workspace.props.n: New workspace name. Leave empty to keep the current name.
actions.opnform_update_workspace.props.w: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.
actions.opnform_update_workspace_user_ro: Workspace role: admin, user (can edit forms) or readonly.
Numeric user ID of the member, from List Workspace Users.
Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.
